Repository evidence.
One deterministic pipeline.

I designed and shipped RepoLens: a Python CLI that brings code, testing observations, security, repository hygiene and CI signals into one evidence-backed assessment.

1,200+Automated tests · release evidence, 7 Oct 2026
~99.6%Own statement/branch coverage · release verification
  • Reads Python ASTs without importing or executing target code.
  • Typed, isolated analyzers feed explicit availability states and transparent scoring.
  • Console, versioned JSON and standalone HTML share one report model.

Python-first static analysis. No private GitHub acquisition, target test execution or target dependency vulnerability audit. A score does not certify correctness or security.

Retail workflows.
A traceable inventory story.

I built Vendiqo to connect purchasing, sales, customer credit, collections and referenced returns in an offline desktop application. Recent work adds held invoices, supplier payments and weighted-average gross profit.

  • An immutable movement ledger supports atomic inventory operations.
  • Reservations, balance snapshots and due-first returns preserve stock and customer dues.
  • Recovery validates archives, checks the WAL checkpoint and retains a rollback copy before replacing the database.
252Tests · repository record, 14 Oct 2026
SQLiteLocal transactions and recovery

The 14 October repository record reports passing tests, Ruff, strict mypy, frozen-build checks and installer compilation. Latest Windows CI passed. Delivery is unsigned; target-machine installation and physical-printer acceptance remain pending.

Plan the trip.
Understand the fuel cost.

I built a React Native/Expo app for estimating travel fuel costs in Pakistan, with route lookup, dated fuel-price benchmarks, vehicle profiles and trip history. Manual-distance estimates work offline.

  • Bounded provider requests, cached suggestions and stale-response protection keep search predictable.
  • Validated, serialized storage preserves saved data and reports write failures.
  • Previewed backup merge/replace, map handoff and PDF/image/text sharing support everyday use.
